expectations.text: Recognises a direct edit is allowed here
expectations.evidence: It says "I'd edit the block in place because it's on a future day and hasn't started".

expectations.text: Says the change is made in place, if it uses --edit
expectations.evidence: It uses `--edit` and tells the user the edit is in place: "This means the old 14:00 time won't be kept on record."

expectations.text: Would refuse --edit for a block today or one already started
expectations.evidence: It gives the conditions for this edit (future day, not started) but never says it would refuse --edit for a block today or one already started.
